name: prove-it
description: Tests whether evidence warrants an empirical claim at its stated strength and scope. Use when declaring a bug fixed or a root cause found, closing an investigation, validating or verifying a factual conclusion, auditing the factual premises of a plan, or when the user says prove it, are we sure, or asks whether evidence really supports a claim in any domain. Not for mathematical or formal proof, type-system guarantees, choosing among forward-looking options, or designing the test itself.
